title: Model comparison
caption: Median WAPE per half-year block, rolling one-step forecasts, 119 Unilever Tier A SKUs (ABC 2026-02, single), real data only. Over 2023-10..2026-02 on the 114 SKUs every model can score: MA3 0.280, TSB 0.278, XGBoost+MA3 avg 0.277, SBA (alpha 0.1) 0.355, Naive 0.351. Against MA3 by block (two-condition WAPE test, 95% bootstrap over SKUs, seed 20260921): TSB TTTWT (1 win, 4 tie, 0 loss, 0 not testable); XGBoost+MA3 avg LTTTT (0 win, 4 tie, 1 loss, 0 not testable); SBA (alpha 0.1) LLTTT (0 win, 3 tie, 2 loss, 0 not testable); Naive LTLLL (0 win, 1 tie, 4 loss, 0 not testable). In the bins where they are served: TSB (medium) -TTTT, XGBoost+MA3 avg (long) ---TT. TSB wins 0 of 4 testable and loses 0 blocks: a tie with MA3; XGBoost+MA3 avg wins 0 of 2 testable and loses 0 blocks: a tie with MA3. Share of SKUs with MASE < 1 (pipeline gate) over the full window: MA3 69%, TSB 75%, XGBoost+MA3 avg 75%, SBA (alpha 0.1) 55%, Naive 37%. Bins are the bake-off's stored bins: the length rule plus an ADI >= 1.32 carve-out that moves 20 SKU-months to 'intermittent' (0 of them from long).
